title: My Collection
description:
This application makes it easy to manage and list your collection.
It is designed to help you manage your collection and provide a clear overview of information about it.
The application is a practice project built with Vue 3 using the Composition API.
You can add, edit, and delete items in your collection and browse them in different views.
The application supports multiple languages and lets you change the language in the interface.
It also includes a dark mode that you can enable according to your preference.

ChatGPT AI was used to help create this application.
